body:
## Why

Asked 2026-09-22: "My approval was blocked for fare comparison. What is the lowest economy fare Seattle to Chicago on Oct 5, and what do I need to attach?" The planner replied:
- "What I heard — **Destinations: My, What, Seattle**" (capitalised words extracted as places);
- "**No policy preview is available** in the current workspace data yet" — a verdict had been received two minutes earlier;
- a long route listing, ending with "the planner is offline and cannot answer free-text questions with generative AI".

## Tasks
- [ ] Restrict destination extraction to places that resolve in `trip_planner/geo/resolver.py`.
- [ ] Read the saved proposal/verdict before saying none exists.
- [ ] Put the offline limitation first, next to the composer, and answer the questions it can (what the blocking codes mean, what TPP needs).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] **Test gate** planner turn test: the message above yields no destination "My" or "What", and with a saved blocked verdict the reply names the blocking codes instead of "No policy preview is available". **Deliberate break:** revert the resolver filter — gate fails; revert passes.
title: Planner chat reads 'My' and 'What' as destinations and denies a verdict that exists
